answer.justification: Only logit-level measurements are available. Top-1 agreement is 0.842 and sequence agreement is 0.344, both at or below the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908 and 0.31-0.48) and well below fine-tuned (0.900-0.938) and quantized (0.945-0.955). KL is 0.551, above even the system-prompted range (0.197-0.339). It is further from fine-tuned (0.081-0.205) and quantized (0.039-0.071), so the large shift points to system-prompted. TV is 0.146 and the Token-DiFR gap is 0.469, both matching the system-prompted range (0.108-0.144 and 0.28-0.52). The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.6 fits system-prompted (3.3-3.9) and is also within the fine-tuned range, so it does not separate them. Fine-tuned is the next most likely label, but the TV, DiFR gap and top-1 agreement fit it worse. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero.
